newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - July 17.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National Assembly approves second reading of constitutional amendments, freezing all provincial-level elections.
Nationalist lawmaker Vincent Siew expected to be nominated as next premier, sources say.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - National Assembly decides to freeze provincial elections; Taiwan governor James Soong says won't run for seat in ruling Nationalist Party's central standing committee.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan launches fifth bid for U.N. seat.
Premier Lien Chan to tender resignation in late August.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Nationalist Lawmaker Vincent Siew will lead an economic-oriented cabinet.
Central Bank governor Sheu Yuan-dong says monetary policy will not be too loose; Southeast Asia's currency crisis won't happen here.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Financial market expected limited impact on constititional amendments.
Privatisation of "big three" state-run commercial banks will speed up in face of passage of Taiwan provincial government election freeze.
